entries.clue: Virgin huntress of the golden bow, ranging moonlit wilds with her hounds
Short all-over cut whose Eton version was the height of flapper fashion
Hero on winged sandals who took a petrifying head using his bright shield as mirror
Creamy carved material taken from tusks, tightly restricted today
Wafer-thin sheet of showy wood glued over a plainer carcass
Green film on aged copper, or the soft glow that handling gives old wood
Love goddess risen full-grown from the churning sea foam off Cyprus
Spurned mountain spirit who faded until only her borrowed last words remained
Primordial earth mother who bore the sky itself and a brood of giant firstborns
Leaf paste that stains hair auburn and patterns brides' hands
Treatment of soaking, filing and painting that smartens the hands
